employees_staff_user_uq.name: employees_staff_user_uq
employees_staff_user_uq.where: "employees"."staff_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "employees"."deleted_at" IS NULL

employee_mentions_once.name: employee_mentions_once
employee_mentions_once.where: "employee_mentions"."employee_id" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_mentions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

employee_mentions_who_check.name: employee_mentions_who_check
employee_mentions_who_check.value: "employee_mentions"."employee_id" IS NOT NULL OR nullif(trim("employee_mentions"."name_as_written"), '') IS NOT NULL

feedback_not_empty_check.name: feedback_not_empty_check
feedback_not_empty_check.value: "feedback"."rating" IS NOT NULL OR nullif(trim("feedback"."review"), '') IS NOT NULL

stays_booking_ref_uq.name: stays_booking_ref_uq
stays_booking_ref_uq.where: "stays"."booking_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "stays"."deleted_at" IS NULL

stays_dates_check.name: stays_dates_check
stays_dates_check.value: "stays"."departure_date" IS NULL OR "stays"."arrival_date" IS NULL OR "stays"."departure_date" >= "stays"."arrival_date"

interactions_target_check.name: interactions_target_check
interactions_target_check.value: "interactions"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL OR "interactions"."company_id" IS NOT NULL

notes_target_check.name: notes_target_check
notes_target_check.value: "notes"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL OR "notes"."company_id" IS NOT NULL
